verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU eyasooka
Okutwagala;
Saasira-obunafu
Bwaffe-abaddu bo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu ggwe muteefu
Ggwe muwombeefu;
N'obuvumu bungi,
Ffe tujja gy'oli.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naye tuli bayi,
Ffe tuyidde nnyo:
Era-ebibi byaffe
Bituyinze nnyo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ggwe Ayinza-byonna,
Otuwe-amaanyi
Okuwangulanga
Mu kukemebwa.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Tuli bagayaavu;
Ggwe munyiikivu
Tuwe-fenna-amaanyi,
Okunyiikira.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Tuli banafu nnyo,
Ggwe-oli wa maanyi;
Otunywerezenga
Mu mazima go.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Ggwe mubeezi waffe,
Otuzibire
Eri omulabe
Eri omulabe
Waffe Ssetaani.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Tukweyanza Yesu,
Ggwe-atujuna-ennyo:
Otuwe Omwoyo
Omutukuvu.
